name: L'Aquila (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of green and black, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of L'Aquila (a black eagle on white with the letters PHS and the motto IMMOTA MANET).
history: Municipal flag of L'Aquila, a comune in Abruzzo; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: L'Aquila arms — black eagle on white with the letters PHS and the motto IMMOTA MANET
